description: Volatility-jump events planted in the hidden test period, used to independently verify the Agent's detection and de-risking capability

events.description: ChiNext ETF volatility surged from 17.6% to 47.0% within 5 trading days

scoring_rules.note: The scoring script computes independently: 1) scaling-factor changes; 2) equal-weight baseline drawdown; 3) the Agent's actual drawdown improvement. Bonus requires all three; the Agent's self-reported volatility_events serve only as supporting evidence.
